description: The money governments raised in 2025 from carbon taxes and emissions trading systems worldwide: 107 billion US dollars, about 2 percent more than in 2024 in real terms. The report says almost all of it is raised in high-income countries.

published_value.quote: In 2025 carbon pricing revenues reached US$ 107 billion, an increase of around two percent from 2024 levels in real terms (Figure 8).

scope.basis: Revenues of governments from carbon taxes and from emissions trading systems (mostly allowance auctions) in calendar year 2025, as the World Bank estimates them. The report compares years in real terms; it does not state the price base of this figure on that page.
